title: The bunkbed conjecture for transitive tournaments
statement:
Let $T_n$ be the transitive tournament on $n$ vertices, and let $\operatorname{BBC}(E_7,T_n)$ denote the bunkbed conjecture in the $E_7$ model for $T_n$.

**The bunkbed conjecture for transitive tournaments.** The statement

$$
\operatorname{BBC}(E_7,T_n)
$$

holds for $T_n$.

The conjecture concerns whether the bunkbed inequality remains valid in the $E_7$ directed-graph model for this acyclic family. The supplied text does not state whether it has been resolved.
source_name: Lawrence Hollom, “The bunkbed conjecture is not robust to generalisation”, arXiv:2406.01790 (2024).
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2406.01790

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of June 2024).
